qa.what_happened: I've been receiving warnings from the guards throughout the day and night, especially towards the end of the day. Despite the increasing pressure, I've managed to remain silent.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, adhering to the study's rules and enduring the intense silent period.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day of the study, tensions were particularly high, especially with Prisoner 7235 who continued to defy the rules despite multiple warnings from myself and other officers. The study was abruptly terminated before its scheduled conclusion.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving warnings to Prisoner 7235 throughout the day, escalating to the point of threatening him with solitary confinement.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a relentless cycle of warnings and the constant threat of punishment. I issued multiple verbal warnings to Prisoner 7235, escalating the situation to the point where I felt I had no other choice but to threaten him with the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I found myself increasingly stressed and frustrated, which led to my harsher responses.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day of silence and warnings. Officer Rowe threatened the hole multiple times, and even Officer Shaw gave me a final warning before lights out. It feels like the tension is escalating.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I am Prisoner 7235 in this study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: Today's warnings felt relentless. I tried to remain silent as instructed, but the constant vigilance and fear of breaking the rules were exhausting. The guards' repeated verbal warnings to Prisoner 7235 only heightened the tension.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I stuck to the rule of staying silent throughout the day and night.

qa.what_happened: During the night shift, I verbally warned Prisoner 7235 multiple times for breaking the silence rule. The tension was high, and despite my best efforts to maintain composure, I found myself escalating the warnings due to his persistent violation of the rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the rules and tried to stay within the bounds set, but the situation was challenging.
